channel.title: Happy Hearts at Home
channel.description: Births, losses, and the days after. One mother's account of three babies born, every one of them at home, and two that she did not get to keep.

item.title: Preparing your toddlers for a new sibling
item.description: A scavenger hunt, four clues written in the car, a pink cake, and two small children who had been praying for a sister.

item.title: At 9:43 in the evening
item.description: With all the sweat, and grunts I finally delivered strong, big boy, Hezekiah on my bed at 9:43pm.

item.title: Karis, at dawn
item.description: It was the most smooth and perfect birth. God did the possible and never left my side!

item.title: Why are you so worried?
item.description: Then on September 27, 2017 I had a vision in my dream of God sending an angel to tell me something very comforting.

item.title: Why I chose a midwife
item.description: Choosing a midwife is rapidly growing in popularity around the world. With so much deception out there about midwives women tend to give birth in a Hospital.

item.title: Nine weeks and three days
item.description: To the women who have lost their baby, I grieve with you and it’s not your fault.
